dedupe_keys.name: s10 borehole data el forn andorra

description: Rachael Lau and colleagues publish sample borehole observations from the El Forn landslide above Canillo, Andorra. The 2024 Zenodo workbook is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The linked NHESS paper describes twenty-minute S10 monitoring of displacement, water pressure and shear-band temperature, and explicitly identifies this deposit as sample in situ data. A companion CC BY 4.0 deposit, 11067825, lists interferogram pairs used in the displacement analysis. Together these resources can help calibrate or compare slope-motion models relevant to exposed settlements and infrastructure. The exact time span and variables retained in the sample workbook remain unknown; full field records require a separate enquiry. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this study package. Point measurements and satellite displacement have different spatial support and uncertainty. Files were not downloaded, and neither sensor calibration nor model performance was independently reproduced.
